findings.summary: The setup URL is shown only in a focusable preformatted block, without a keyboard-operable way to copy just the link.
findings.fix: Add a semantic “Copy link” button that copies the URL and reports success or failure; provide a selectable fallback if clipboard access is unavailable.
findings.evidence: <pre class="admin-code" tabindex="0" aria-label="One-time teacher setup link">

notes: The reported preformatted-block issue was fixed after review by replacing it with a labeled, read-only textarea for native keyboard selection and copying. The change was PHP-linted; no specialist re-scan was run.
